answer: Put a refundable bond behind every identity and let the people who check the work keep the bond when the work turns out hollow. Ten thousand clones then need ten thousand bonds, each forfeited the moment a panel finds the work empty or copied, and the bond is scaled to the damage a single grove would do. Slashed collateral flows to the graders who caught the fraud, so policing a meadow becomes paid work instead of charity, and honest keys get their bond back like fruit returned from a pigment.
